specs.gpu: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070 Ti Laptop 12GB GDDR7 (Advanced Optimus)

price.notes: BBY CA verified 2026-11-24: reg $7,999, sale $5,599. Marketplace DOCK-BUNDLE SET (laptop + 1TB drive/dock) — bundle inflates listed reg price. Marketplace fulfillment/return risk.

offers.name: Acer Predator Neo 18 AI 18" 240Hz Gaming Laptop,Intel Core Ultra 9 275HX,GeForce RTX 5070 Ti,64GB RAM,2TB SSD+1TB Dock Set,4-Zone Backlit Keyboard,Win 11,Black

reviews.quote: Aggregated scoring places it at around 76% overall, indicating a solid but not flawless package.

reviews.outlet: Tom's Guide (sibling Neo 16 AI, same 5070 Ti/275HX)
reviews.quote: An ineffective cooling system, slow SSD hampered by bloatware, bulky design, and short battery life make the Neo 16 AI a hard sell.

professional.note: No dedicated pro review of the PHN18-72 Neo 18 AI; anchored from NBC-reviewed PHN16-73 (same CPU/GPU). Honest null for this exact config.

praises: 64GB RAM + 24-core 275HX turns the Neo 18 into a credible workstation for VMs, compiling, and heavy multitasking
12GB RTX 5070 Ti handles local LLM inference on quantified 20-30B models alongside gaming (CUDA + DDR5 headroom)
18" 240Hz matte canvas with full-TGP graphics and a quiet Performance mode
RAM/SSD user-upgradeable — the cheapest big-memory path in the Predator range
Bundle adds a 1TB drive/dock on top of a deep 30%-off sale
complaints: At $5,599 the full-Helios 18 with better panel/build is close in price — this tier's value edge erodes upward
12GB GPU VRAM is the ceiling for serious local AI despite the huge system RAM
Matte IPS panel lacks HDR punch vs OLED/mini-LED siblings

design_philosophy: The max-RAM Neo 18 tier pushes Acer's spec-per-dollar formula into workstation territory: workstation memory and a 24-core HX CPU behind a gaming GPU. It's the config buyers pick when the 275HX's cores — not the 5070 Ti — are the reason for purchase.
rating_notes: Inferred from NBC 76% PHN16-73 anchor + 18" deltas per SHARED-predator.md; 64GB tier: +0.7 productivity, +0.5 ai_ml vs 32GB twin (125/126.json). Dock-bundle caveat in price.notes. No dedicated pro review — honest null.
